definitions.explanation: Doing or being something ahead of others, either in order of action or in arrival. The standard polite phrase when leaving the office early is お{先|さき}に.
Referring back to a recent earlier time. Often replaces this morning, yesterday, or last week when the exact time is irrelevant.

examples.japanese: お{先|さき}に⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧。
{先|さき}に⟦{帰|かえ}ります→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm heading home ahead of you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先|さき}に⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いて→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧おいて⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: He arrived at the venue ahead of us and saved seats.

examples.japanese: {先|さき}に⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I let you know earlier by email.

examples.japanese: {先|さき}に⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{進展|しんてん}→進展：14374_shinten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありました→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: About what I mentioned earlier — has there been any progress?

examples.japanese: {先|さき}にお⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧とおり、⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: As I mentioned earlier, the meeting has been postponed to next week.

notes:
Adverbial use of the noun ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (ahead; tip). Sense 1 is concrete (going first in time or place); sense 2 is the discourse use 'as I said earlier'.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{先|さき}に: 'Excuse me for going first' — standard set phrase when leaving early
- お{先|さき}に{失礼|しつれい}します: polite version, used at work
- {先|さき}に⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧おく: to mention upfront; to warn in advance
- {先|さき}に⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧とおり: as I mentioned earlier

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: before; previously — refers to an earlier point in time, but sounds less formal
- ⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧: previously; formerly — formal written register
- ⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧: quickly; soon — about speed, not order of arrival
